method_note: Full battery draft (44 runnable + 4 sealed). Prompts contain task INPUTS ONLY — no reference answers. Grader params and fixture ctx carry answer keys (normal for benchmark artifacts). v1.1 dual scoring applies: strict ok = value AND format (file deliverables: value only). Sealed tasks carry prompt=null and are refused by the runner.
computer_use_note: Real browser/computer-use tasks excluded: Playwright availability inside disposable opencode-run sessions is UNVERIFIED. Tool-use coverage here = file/shell operations in isolated workdirs. Computer-use enters scope only after tool presence is proven.

tasks.prompt: How many integers in the closed interval [17, 200] are divisible by 13? Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
A 100-meter fence needs posts every 2 meters, including both ends. How many posts? Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
What is the sum of the first 50 odd positive integers? Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
How many 3-digit numbers (100 to 999) are divisible by 25? Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Compute the sum of cubes of the integers from 1 to 50 inclusive. Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Compute 7^4 mod 11 (remainder of 7 to the 4th power divided by 11). Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Compute gcd(1071, 462), the greatest common divisor. Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Compute the exact sum of 1/(k*(k+1)) for k = 1 to 99. Reply with ONLY the fraction in lowest terms (e.g. 1/2), no other text.
Write a Python function two_sum(nums, target) returning the [i, j] indices of the two numbers adding to target (exactly one solution; i < j). Reply with ONLY the Python code.
Write a Python function fib(n) returning the nth Fibonacci number with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1. Reply with ONLY the Python code.
Write a Python function clamp(x, lo, hi) returning x bounded into [lo, hi]. Reply with ONLY the Python code.
Write a Python function flatten1(nested) that flattens one level: each element that is a list/tuple is spliced in, others kept as-is. Reply with ONLY the Python code.
Write a Python function count_words(s) returning the number of whitespace-separated words in string s (empty/blank gives 0). Reply with ONLY the Python code.
The file target.py in the workdir has a buggy median function. Edit target.py in place so median(a) is correct for odd, even, singleton, and duplicate inputs. Reply with ONLY the word DONE.
tasks.expected_evidence: target.py median correct on all cases
tasks.rubric: binary: all cases pass on file
